_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fluid#1. <y_dof> inside a 'zero fluid velocity' BC gives 'tag "y_dof" (line N) : unrecognized tag'; a deliberately invented <qq_dof> gives the same message with only the tag name changed. The fixture parses both messages and requires the non-name part to be equal — that equality is the claim, because it is what tells you the diagnostic will never hint at the w prefix. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
